zh.summary: 统一 Windows Portable 更新界面，并为插件安装和更新提供独立的 Beta 选择。
highlights: Portable 更新选择在主窗口内完成；整包更新由沿用窗口尺寸和主题的独立更新器接手。
插件市场安装默认选择正式版，有更新的 Beta 时可明确选择具体 Beta 版本。
已安装插件的正式版更新与 Beta 试用分开显示；Beta 更新复核版本并验证实际安装结果。
knownIssues: 整包更新需要关闭正在替换的桌面程序，因此仍由独立进程完成交接。
upgradeNotes: 退出后升级，保留 data 和 workspace。

en.summary: Unify the Windows Portable update UI and offer an explicit Beta choice for plugin installs and updates.
highlights: Choose Portable updates in the main window; a separate updater takes over full-package replacement with matching window size and theme.
The plugin market installs stable builds by default and offers a specific Beta version only when a newer tagged build exists.
Installed plugins show stable updates and Beta trials separately; Beta updates recheck the tag and verify the resolved version.
knownIssues: Full-package replacement still needs a separate process to take over after the running desktop exits.
upgradeNotes: Exit before upgrading and retain data and workspace.
